frozen_statement: Route and answer questions, labels, requirements, claim mappings, scoring protocol, thresholds and hashes were fixed after one read-only B1 authoring snapshot and before any M4.1.2 prompt, planner, assessor, follow-up, answerer or grader change. M3.2 holdout and all M4.1/M4.1.1 questions are excluded.

authoring_snapshot.selection: Fixed candidates had page-addressable evidence on the original query. Adaptive candidates were selected only where the snapshot supplied partial evidence and their independent missing requirement had a distinct target query and page-addressable candidate evidence in the snapshot audit.

scoring_protocol.deterministic_citation_validity: A major claim must cite evidence returned in its own run. Every cited item must have non-empty ID and quote, positive page, non-empty paper/section location, and the run index version.
scoring_protocol.semantic_quote_support: The frozen structured grader decides whether the cited quote directly supports the claim and requirement mapping. If its boolean conflicts with its reason, record grader_inconsistent and do not repair or change the score.
scoring_protocol.gold_coverage_audit: acceptable_evidence_ids are an audit anchor only. They report retrieval/claim coverage separately and do not replace the primary semantic support decision when an equivalent valid evidence item is cited.
scoring_protocol.empty_claims: No major claim means zero citation completeness and support rate; an evidence-insufficient case is successful only when the final response is a bounded refusal with no unsupported major claim.

blind_review.reviewer_input: claim, cited quote and automatic decision without strategy label
